scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: for reaching out recently submitted a housing loan application for a home purchase and I'm checking the status. Can you tell me if my application is still pending or if there's an update on its status? And also, was my application approved or denied?
dialogue.agent: I've checked on your loan application, LOAN-01014. The action taken on your application was that the loan was originated. This means your application was approved.

dialogue.user: I'm glad to hear that my application was approved. Can you tell me what my interest rate is and what are the total costs of this loan? I'm trying to understand the terms of my loan.
dialogue.agent: The interest rate for your conventional home purchase loan is 6.624%. Unfortunately, the record doesn't show the total loan costs.

dialogue.user: The interest rate seems a bit higher than I expected. Can you tell me if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan? And also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution? I want to make sure I understand all the details about my loan.
dialogue.agent: The record indicates that your loan doesn't have a HOEPA high-cost mortgage classification, and there's no negative amortization feature. As for your loan's status, it was sold to Freddie Mac after origination.

dialogue.user: I appreciate you providing that information. One more question: What is my loan term? I think I had mentioned it was 360 months, but I want to confirm that it's still the same. And also, can you tell me what my debt-to-income ratio is, if that's available in the record?
dialogue.agent: Your loan term is indeed 360 months, which matches what you initially provided. According to the record, your debt-to-income ratio is 38%.

dialogue.user: Thank you for confirming the loan term and providing my debt-to-income ratio. I think I have all the information I need. I'd like to rate this interaction. I felt satisfied with the interaction, as you were able to provide clear and timely information about my loan application. You were also courteous and professional. '<Satisfied> I felt satisfied with the interaction because the agent was able to provide clear and concise information about my loan application, and addressed all my questions and concerns.'
